headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a close game, and the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners have placed Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. Joe Ryan of the Minnesota Twins has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, with a left glute strain. The Cleveland Guardians have placed Slade Cecconi on the 15-day injured list with right arm fatigue.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of first baseman Jacob Berry in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics have also made a trade, acquiring Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Athletics 6-5 in a close game, securing their win. Brian Serven led the Athletics' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Dominant 13-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a convincing win over the Cleveland Guardians, outscoring them 13-6. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Brewers in 5-2 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status on the injured list will be reassessed after 10 days.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
